correct_completion: I would have passed the exam.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
acceptable_variants: I would have got a better grade.
I might have passed the exam.

options.text: I will pass the exam tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This is a future statement, not a past hypothetical result; the third conditional needs 'would have' plus a past participle.

options.text: I would have passed the exam.
I would pass the exam every day.
options.why_wrong: 'Every day' describes a habit, not a past result that did not happen.
'So' introduces a real past result, but the stem is hypothetical, so the main clause must use 'would have'.

grammar_focus: Third conditional: unreal past situations and their results
explanation: The third conditional describes an unreal past situation. Use 'had' plus a past participle in the if-clause and 'would have' plus a past participle in the main clause.
translation: Si hubiera estudiado más duro, habría aprobado el examen.
